name: fix-adds-new-defect

openThread.title: `fetchWithRetry` retries forever
openThread.description: `fetchWithRetry` loops with `while (true)` and no attempt limit, so while the server keeps answering 503 or the host stays down, the caller waits forever.
openThread.suggestedFix: Stop after a fixed number of attempts, such as five.

roundFindings.title: `fetchWithRetry` returns `undefined` when every attempt throws
roundFindings.description: When every `fetch` call throws, as while the host is down, `last` is never set and `return last!` hands the caller `undefined` typed as a `Response`. The caller then fails with a `TypeError` on its first property read, far from the cause.
